name: [🍄] Grow a Mushroom
desc:
Welcome to Grow A Mushroom! 🍄

👍 Like the game & join the group for updates!

Plant, grow, harvest, and sell a huge variety of mushrooms! Unlock rare and mythical mushroom seeds, upgrade your garden, and trade your harvest for money. Compete to grow the biggest and rarest mushrooms in the game!

How To Play:
🌱 Buy mushroom seeds from the Seed Shop.
🍄 Plant your seeds in your garden and watch them grow.
💰 Harvest your mushrooms and sell them for money to unlock new types!

Your mushrooms keep growing while you are offline! 💤

⚠️ THIS GAME IS IN ALPHA! EXPECT BUGS & CHANGES

Inspired by Grow A Garden
